name: xianxia-idle
description: Path to Immortality — a Chinese cultivation (xianxia) idle game for Android & iOS.

scripts.cap:add:android: npm i @capacitor/core @capacitor/android && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm i @capacitor/core @capacitor/ios && npx cap add ios
scripts.release:android: npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease && echo '\n✅ AAB ready: android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab'
